thread:
maria: Quick favor — can someone run nsys + torch.prof on the batch-eval that regressed on staging? I can provide the sample input and the small runner. Need traces for p99 spike investigation.

arjun: I can pick this up in ~2h. Which model + batch size? also do you want full sequence or short-circuit (seq len 128)?

maria: model=redwood/3b-open, bs=8, seq=512 (same as nightly). Full sequence please — we saw the p99 jump on long tails.

arjun: ok. will run nsys (kernel + nvtx) + torch.prof in torch 2.x compat mode. any special env?

maria: set OMP_NUM_THREADS=4, TORCH_USE_CUDA_DSA=0, and use the eval config from repo: `configs/eval/batch_eval_long.yaml`.

sasha: I can do the trace upload once it's done. we use s3 prefix `s3://redwood-perf/traces/batch-eval/` and name as `<gitsha>-3223456789.nsys.tgz` — include `torchprof.json` alongside.

perf-bot: perf-ci: alert for nightly/batch-eval — p99 latency +18% vs baseline (2026-03-16). See CI run: https://ci.redwood.dev/runs/5472

kevin: small tip — enable `record_shapes=True` and `profile_memory=True` in torch.profiler so we can disambiguate allocs. Also please capture `stack` on backward if possible: `with profiler.profile(record_shapes=True, profile_memory=True, with_stack=True):`

lisa: I can smoke-run on an rtx8000 here to sanity-check the capture; will do 5 iterations and a short nvtx timeline to keep artifact size small.

arjun: plan: 1) run 3 warmup iters, 2) capture 20 iters with nsys range start/stop around forward pass, 3) torch.profiler outer context. I'll compress and upload. tagging @sasha for upload.

maria: thanks — please paste the s3 link here when uploaded. if you see a KV-cache miss storm, annotate the trace with `KV_MISS` nvtx ranges. :thumbsup:

arjun: got it, starting in ~20m. will post link when done. :rocket:
